name: log_check_in
description: Save the patient's finished check-in to CloudCare so the care team can see it and the risk model can score it. Call this once, right after the patient has answered the check-in questions. The reply has risk.risk_level (low, medium, or high) and escalated (true when the care team was alerted).

pain_level.description: Pain right now on a scale from 0 to 10, as the patient said it. Whole number from 0 to 10.

shortness_of_breath.description: True only if the patient said they have trouble breathing or shortness of breath. Otherwise false.

swelling.description: True only if the patient said they have new or worse swelling. Otherwise false.

nausea.description: True only if the patient said they feel sick to their stomach or are throwing up. Otherwise false.

wound_redness.description: True only if the patient said the incision is more red. Otherwise false.

wound_drainage.description: True only if the patient said fluid or pus is coming from the incision. Otherwise false.

mobility_level.description: How well the patient is moving, 0 to 4. 4 means walking as planned with the walker, 3 means walking a little less than planned, 2 means walking only a few steps, 1 means mostly in bed or chair, 0 means unable to get up or had a fall. Use 4 if the patient did not say anything about moving.

free_text.description: One or two plain sentences summarizing the check-in answers in the patient's words: pain, whether they took their medicine as planned, any new numbness, tingling, or color change in the leg or foot, and any falls.
